requirement_text: The system must provide a mobile application for both Android and iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."

user_story.user_story:
As a mobile football fan, I want to use the app on Android or iOS so that I can access its features on my device.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I use a supported Android or iOS device
When I install and launch the application
Then the system must provide the mobile football app on that platform.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to register and log in directly at app startup.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to register and log in at startup so that I can quickly access personalized app features.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I open the app for the first time or am signed out
When I choose to register or log in from the startup flow
Then the system must allow me to complete authentication from the app startup screen.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to select favorite teams to personalize their app experience.
requirement_reference: "users can display current football news of their favorite teams" and "Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to follow favorite clubs so that the app can personalize content for me.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am in the personalization or preferences area
When I select one or more favorite teams
Then the system must save those teams as my favorites.

requirement_text: The system must display current football news for users’ favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "users can display current football news of their favorite teams"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to see current news for my favorite teams so that I can stay informed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have selected one or more favorite teams
When I view the news section
Then the system must display current football news related to those favorite teams.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to individually select preferred sports channels for news content.
requirement_reference: "also select preferred sports channels individually"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to choose preferred sports channels so that I can tailor the news sources I see.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am in the content preferences area
When I select one or more sports channels
Then the system must save and apply my selected sports channels.

requirement_text: The system must provide a live ticker for users to follow live results of their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker" and "give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to follow my favorite teams via a live ticker so that I can track match results as they happen.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have selected favorite teams and a match is in progress
When I open the live ticker
Then the system must display live result information for those teams.

requirement_text: The system must include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves and displays live match data in real time.
requirement_reference: "the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want live ticker data to update in real time so that I receive current match information.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a live match is ongoing
When the live ticker receives updated match data
Then the system must display the updated live data in the app without requiring a manual refresh.

requirement_text: The system must retrieve live data for the live ticker via an API from an external server.
requirement_reference: "The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server."

user_story.user_story:
As a product owner, I want the app to retrieve live match data from an external API so that live information can be provided dynamically.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the live ticker module requests match updates
When a configured external API endpoint is available
Then the system must retrieve live data from the external server API.

requirement_text: The system must provide extensive coverage of national and international leagues and competitions.
requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want access to national and international league coverage so that I can follow a wide range of competitions.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I browse competitions in the app
When I access league and competition content
Then the system must present coverage for national and international competitions.

requirement_text: The system must provide detailed team information.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to view detailed team information so that I can learn more about clubs I follow.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I open a team detail page
When team data exists
Then the system must display detailed team information.

requirement_text: The system must provide detailed player information.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to view detailed player information so that I can learn more about players.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I open a player detail page
When player data exists
Then the system must display detailed player information.

requirement_text: The system must display live stream links in the app for available live broadcasts.
requirement_reference: "Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to access live stream links in the app so that I can quickly navigate to available live broadcasts.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a supported live broadcast has begun
When I view the relevant match or stream area in the app
Then the system must display the corresponding live stream link.

requirement_text: The system must only display live stream links when transmission rights are valid for the user’s country.
requirement_reference: "Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to see only legally available stream links so that I access broadcasts available in my country.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a live stream exists for a match
When I access the stream link from a country without valid rights
Then the system must not display the live stream link.
Given a live stream exists for a match
When I access the stream link from a country with valid rights
Then the system must display the live stream link.

requirement_text: The user interface must provide direct access to information in the app.
requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want direct access to app information through the interface so that I can quickly reach the content I need.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am using the app interface
When I navigate to a supported information area
Then the system must allow direct access to that information through the user interface.

requirement_text: The system must support additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app through the user interface.
requirement_reference: "the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface"

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want configurable app modules so that I can tailor the app to my preferences.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given configurable modules are available
When I modify module-related settings in the app
Then the system must save and apply my individual configuration through the user interface.

requirement_text: The system must provide a notification function that, when activated by the user, sends information about current events.
requirement_reference: "the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated"

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to activate notifications for current events so that I receive timely updates.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given notifications are enabled for my account or device
When a current event relevant to the app occurs
Then the system must send a notification to me.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to receive notifications about news or results of their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want notifications about news and results for my favorite teams so that I stay updated without opening the app.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I follow a favorite team and have enabled notifications
When news or result updates are available for that team
Then the system must send me a notification about that news or result.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to share news and game reports directly from the app via social media.
requirement_reference: "users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app"

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to share news and game reports to social media from the app so that I can share content easily.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing a news item or game report
When I choose the share option
Then the system must allow me to share the content through supported social media channels.

requirement_text: The system must keep the user interface and app modules as fixed app components that remain consistent when external server updates occur.
requirement_reference: "All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app interface and modules to remain consistent during external data updates so that my experience is stable.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the app receives updated data from an external server
When the update is processed
Then the system must preserve the defined user interface structure and app modules.

requirement_text: The system must support continuous evaluation of user feedback and app reviews to inform functionality improvements.
requirement_reference: "user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality"

user_story.user_story:
As a product team member, I want user feedback and app reviews to be evaluated so that functionality can be improved over time.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given users submit feedback or app reviews are available
When the product team performs evaluation activities
Then the system or process must make those inputs available for continuous review and improvement actions.
